segments.speaker: CFO Nadia
segments.text: Marketing spend is twenty percent over budget this quarter.

segments.speaker: Head of Marketing Leo
segments.text: Most of that is the trade show, which was approved in January.

segments.speaker: CFO Nadia
segments.text: Understood. Going forward, any spend above ten thousand needs my sign-off.

segments.speaker: CEO Arun
segments.text: Agreed, let's make that the policy from next month.

segments.speaker: CFO Nadia
segments.text: Leo, please send me a revised forecast for Q4.

segments.speaker: Head of Marketing Leo
segments.text: Will do, I'll have it ready by the end of next week.

segments.speaker: CEO Arun
segments.text: We might also need to freeze hiring, but let's not decide that today.
